name: 22 St John Street
summary: A Grade II listed Georgian terrace in Manchester's legal quarter, being restored as characterful workspace with original fireplaces, sash windows and a landscaped rear courtyard.

name: Barnett House
summary: A 1930s former office building close to Piccadilly, being converted to forty-two design-led apartments with a residents' lounge and roof terrace.

name: Chester House
summary: A red-brick landmark on the edge of Altrincham town centre, approaching practical completion as twenty-eight apartments a short walk from the Metrolink and the market quarter.

name: Barrington Road
summary: A brownfield infill site delivering townhouses and duplexes around a shared garden square, designed to knit into Altrincham's Victorian street grain.

name: Court House
summary: The former county court in central Stockport, in pre-construction for a mixed-use restoration combining workspace, hospitality and civic space within the retained courtroom interiors.

name: Davenport
summary: A suburban consolidation scheme beside Davenport station, delivering family homes and apartments with direct rail links into Manchester Piccadilly.
